Brentford Football Club is a professional association football club based in Brentford, London, England. The team competes in the Premier League, the top tier of English football. Nicknamed \"The Bees\", the club was founded in 1889 and played home matches at Griffin Park from 1904 before moving to the Brentford Community Stadium in 2020.
